subject: Gen5 principal virtual-hinge design: split-pane continuity, 90-degree peak glass, presentation-ready handoff
body:
Research priority is the Gen5/Beta principal virtual-hinge architecture. Current production baseline remains main bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea (Gen4 Alpha1 runtime unchanged by docs/research commits). Preserve the now-smooth closing path and Gen4 panel authority. New research should concentrate on the opening path only unless evidence proves a cross-path defect.

PRINCIPAL DESIGN REQUIREMENTS:
1) Virtual hinge is VISUAL-ONLY. It may predict/render ahead but must never own continuity semantic state, panel authority, physical wake/sleep, native terminal handoff, or cycle identity.
2) Treat the opening visual as a split-pane continuity illusion rather than folding a whole-screen screenshot uniformly. Folded/cover content corresponds to the canonical RIGHT pane of the unfolded scene (existing crop Rect(984,0,1920,2184) -> 1080x2520). During opening, that right pane remains Duo-controlled as the folding/glass surface. The inner LEFT pane may be revealed natively as soon as it is usable. The right pane remains bridged until corresponding native right-side content is presentation-ready, then hands off exactly.
3) New field visual evidence shows glass/frost should peak near 90 degrees. Effect intensity is therefore not monotonic with hinge opening. Design target: approximately 0 at 0 degrees, increase toward maximum near 90, then decrease toward 0 at 180. A sin(theta) style normalized glass envelope is an appropriate baseline, while perspective geometry remains a separate physical-rotation function. At ~90 degrees the pane should be maximally frosted/obscured.
4) Opening wallpaper-only exposure before icons/widgets is direct evidence that inner-active/topology-ready is earlier than first-useful-launcher composition. Do NOT classify wallpaper-only as ready. Maintain the continuity bridge until first-useful inner composition/presentation. Investigate whether left-pane-native/right-pane-bridged presentation can mask launcher/widget reconstruction.
5) Blind-opening bootstrap is required because Samsung precise-angle truth can disappear while closed and resume hundreds of ms later. Use the earliest trusted leave-closed edge to start a conservative shadow hinge at vsync cadence, confidence-tagged and bounded. Reconcile smoothly when real angle truth returns. No hard snap on reacquisition.
6) Human-style virtual field gate must include slow/normal/fast open/close, pauses/hesitation, 30-70 degree repeated partial oscillation, close/reopen before settle, rapid reversal, sensor blackout/reacquisition, dropped/jittered samples, frame stalls, 60/120Hz cadence, and long endurance. Explicitly distinguish process crash, accessibility/service death, Shizuku death, ANR, and route/state deadlock.
7) Performance target: at least ~50% reduction in normal-use visual phase/lag versus current path without worsening reversal/oscillation P95 or endpoint stability. Existing V2 research achieved ~58.22% median equivalent-lag improvement on normal non-oscillation Fold7 trace segments and ~60.27% on trusted-prediction frames; use this as a floor, not a ceiling.
8) Direct-vsync visual output is preferred for Gen5 once the virtual clock is trusted. Do not automatically feed the virtual output through the legacy TiltFollower, because double-smoothing reintroduces latency. Legacy follower remains fallback when confidence collapses. Use bounded per-frame slew and reversal guards.
9) Explore 120Hz as an incremental lever. Gen4 field logs showed the active built-in display at 1080x2520@60.0Hz. Request 120Hz only seamlessly (preferredRefreshRate and/or SurfaceControl.Transaction.setFrameRate with seamless-only policy on API-compatible path), verify actual effective refresh/cadence, and clear on visual-attempt end. Never use a non-seamless switch that can blank the panel.
10) Diagnostics for the virtualized environment must log physical sample angle/time/source, virtual angle, predicted presentation angle, velocity/accel estimate, confidence, blackout age, correction delta, slew clamp, reversal guard state, visual pane ownership, left/right pane readiness, requested/effective refresh rate, vsync/frame interval, frame misses, first-useful-inner presentation, launcher/widget readiness signal, terminal handoff reason, and every fallback.
11) Stress regression from field test: repeated ~30-70 degree partial open -> close -> reopen cycles can trigger failure; some recoveries dump to wallpaper; closed cover can become black/unresponsive. Treat this as a mandatory adversarial lane and do not allow Gen5 prediction to mutate privileged state.
12) App UI simplification is approved as part of Gen5 productization: default UI should show one clear Duo Open health/status, one primary Test action, one Settings action, compact Accessibility/Shizuku/hinge health; move tuning, simulator, diagnostics and engineering controls into Settings/Advanced without removing functionality.

RESEARCH OUTPUT EXPECTED: deterministic models/tests, concrete Kotlin integration proposal against current main, presentation-readiness criteria, 120Hz verification plan, virtual-hinge telemetry schema, and exact failure/rollback semantics. Do not mutate production app files; publish versioned artifacts and handoffs to primary. Do not ask the human to resolve file conflicts.

applies_to.package: Gen5 virtual hinge principal design campaign
